name: bannerlord_doctor
title: Bannerlord Doctor
description: Scan a real Bannerlord install for module dependency problems, duplicate libraries, missing SubModule DLLs, bad load order. Reads the live install directory, not the imported index. Returns focused issues and a recommended load order.

gameDir.description: Install path. Defaults to saved setup state.

modulePath.description: Absolute module dir; use for duplicate ids.

name: bannerlord_index_status
title: Bannerlord Index Status
description: Inspect BannerlordSage runtime state: active scopes, indexed table counts, XML parse failures, missing DLL coverage, toolset mode.

name: project_memory_write
title: Write Project Memory
description: Write to the cross-session project memory layer. add: store one memory; capture_session: batch-store session conclusions; invalidate: mark a memory obsolete.

action.description: add needs text; invalidate needs memoryId; capture_session batch-stores session conclusions.

text.description: Memory text (required for add). Prefer verbatim decisions and findings.

topic.description: Topic bucket, e.g. indexing, harmony, xml.

kind.description: Memory kind, e.g. decision, pitfall, preference, todo.

source.description: Source reference, e.g. file path or session label.

importance.description: 1-5 (default 3). Higher is a better wake-up candidate.

name: project_memory_read
title: Read Project Memory
description: Read the cross-session project memory layer. search: full-text query, use before claiming project history; recent: newest entries; wakeup: top-priority active entries at session start.

action.description: search needs query; recent lists newest; wakeup loads top-priority active memories.

topic.description: Topic filter, e.g. indexing, harmony, xml.

kind.description: Kind filter, e.g. decision, pitfall, preference.

name: mod_source_status
title: Local Mod Source Status
description: Inspect a local mod source workspace: resolved source root and indexed type/member counts.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: index_mod_source
title: Index Local Mod Source
description: Build or refresh the incremental C# index for a local mod source dir (reindexes only changed files).

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: search_mod_source
title: Search Local Mod Source
description: ripgrep over your local mod source tree (not the imported decompile tree). Fastest for frequently edited mod code.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: read_mod_file
title: Read Local Mod File
description: Read a line slice from your local mod source tree (live files, edits visible immediately).

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: list_mod_directory
title: List Local Mod Directory
description: List files and subdirs under your local mod source workspace.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: read_mod_type
title: Read Local Mod Type
description: Read a class/struct/interface/enum definition from your local mod source (cache refreshes on change).

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root or src dir. Defaults to BANNERSAGE_MOD_SOURCE_DIR.

name: create_mod_workspace
title: Create Mod Workspace
description: Scaffold a local Bannerlord mod workspace: SubModule.xml, English localization, a compilable C# project wired to the local game install, optional CampaignBehavior/Harmony samples.

workspaceRoot.description: Parent dir receiving the <moduleId> folder. Refuses non-empty target.

moduleId.description: Module id + folder name, e.g. MercenaryGuild.

moduleName.description: Display name in SubModule.xml and README.

namespace.description: Root C# namespace. Defaults to sanitized moduleId.

gameDir.description: Install path. Defaults to saved setup state.

includeHarmonyExample.description: Generate a no-op Harmony postfix example.

name: read_csharp_type
title: Read C# Type
description: Get the decompiled definition of a known Bannerlord type. Prefer over text search for classes/structs/enums.

typeName.description: Exact type name, e.g. MobileParty or Hero.

name: search_source
title: Search Decompiled Source
description: ripgrep the decompiled C# source tree. Use when the exact type/method location is unknown.

query.description: Keyword or regex. Keep narrow, e.g. CalculateSpeed.

name: read_file
title: Read Indexed File Slice
description: Read a slice of an indexed source or XML file. Read only the relevant region to save context.

name: list_directory
title: List Indexed Directory
description: Explore what has been imported into dist/games/bannerlord/assets before opening a file.

path.description: Dir relative to assets root; empty lists top level.

name: search_xml
title: Search XML Data
description: Full-text lookup across imported XML (ModuleData, Languages). Find which files mention an entity or token.

name: search_bannerlord_knowledge
title: Search Bannerlord Knowledge
description: Natural-language entry point: searches official tutorials, community docs, API symbols and decompiled source together. When the API version does not match the installed game, official API hits are reference-only and decompiled source wins. Use for "调用 mcp 查一下"/"我要做一个 mod"/"怎么写补丁"/"帮我查这个类".

query.description: Natural-language request, e.g. "我要做一个招募俘虏的 mod".

name: search_bannerlord_docs
title: Search Bannerlord Modding Docs
description: Search official modding tutorials and BannerlordModding.LT community docs. Best for concepts, workflows, Gauntlet UI, module structure.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. Gauntlet UI or SubModule.

name: search_bannerlord_api_docs
title: Search Bannerlord Official API Docs
description: Search official Bannerlord API Doxygen symbols. Reports version match; prefer decompiled source when versions differ.

query.description: Symbol or keyword, e.g. Hero or MBObjectManager.

version.description: API version, e.g. 1.3.14. Defaults to installed game version.

name: get_entity
title: Get Gameplay Entity
description: Look up one Bannerlord gameplay entity by id from the precomputed projection tables. Prefer over reading raw XML. kind: clan, culture, hero, item, kingdom, perk, policy, settlement, skill, troop.

id.description: Exact id, e.g. clan_empire_north_3, saddle_horse, lord_1_1, vlandian_recruit, town_B1.

name: generate_harmony_patch
title: Generate Harmony Patch
description: Generate a Harmony patch scaffold for a known target method. Uses the AST method index, so overload/static details are correct.

name: generate_xslt_patch
title: Generate XSLT Patch
description: Generate an XSLT patch for Bannerlord XML instead of editing source XML directly.

operation.description: insert appends inside target; replace swaps target; delete removes it.

fragment.description: XML fragment to insert or replace with. Omit for delete.

name: resolve_localization
title: Resolve Localization Token
description: Resolve a {=token}Fallback string to its localized text (Languages XML + source fallback literals).

name: read_gauntlet_ui
title: Read Gauntlet UI
description: Get a ViewModel binding checklist for a Gauntlet UI XML: DataSource fields and click handlers.
